narrative.overview: Each of Kairo's apps is drawn as the thing it is: Chrono a watch dial, Ledger a cloth notebook with a gold ribbon, the command palette a keycap, Kairo itself a ring with one stretch of it lit gold, the moment. They sit on a sheet of cream paper by day, or on deep blue ink by night (the default), with a faint grain over the ground. Everything else is ruled lines, small capitals and quiet sheets, so the objects and the numbers carry the character.
keyCharacteristics: Real objects as app marks, drawn inline in each app's ink; no image files.
Two grounds: deep blue ink (default) and cream paper, each with a fine grain.
Fraunces 800 for titles and figures, with an italic 400 aside in the app's ink.
Section labels in small capitals with wide letter-spacing.
Kairo's own controls everywhere the system's would ignore the theme: dropdowns, the calendar, time lists.

rules.name: The Whose Window Rule
rules.body: Accent colour comes from --app, never a literal: the same component is blue in Chrono and amber in Ledger.

rules.name: The Fill Is Not Ink Rule
rules.body: A data colour used as small text takes its -ink variant; fills keep the original so charts read the same.

rules.name: The Two Weights Rule
rules.body: Fraunces is 800 or an italic 400 aside; nothing in between.

rules.name: The Float Only Rule
rules.body: Strong shadows belong to what floats above the page (popovers, lists, the palette); everything at rest is a sheet.

dos: Do take every colour from the tokens on :root, and define a new one for both grounds.
Do use --app for accents and the -ink variants for data colours as text.
Do draw icons and marks inline in the 24-unit stroke family (or the 100-unit object drawings in src/logos.ts).
Do give every motion an alternative under prefers-reduced-motion.
Do change the native Windows palette and ring in step with the web ones when a shared value moves.
donts: Don't use the system's date, time or select pickers; they ignore the theme.
Don't remove the outline on focus without putting a solid one back.
Don't set small text in the faint grey below 4.5:1, or a data fill colour as words.
Don't hard-code a colour in a component.
Don't add image files for marks or icons.
